project_type: Python WiFi reconnaissance and attack framework
build_system: setup.py with no build step required
test_framework: No test suite present - validation by syntax/import check
test_command: python -c "import posframework; from posframework import recon, karma, beacons, deauth, mitm, dns_spoof, ssl_strip, orchestrator, rogueap"
verification_instructions: Run python syntax check on all modified files and import validation
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no pip install, no Docker. Use pre-installed Python for AST/syntax validation only.
contribution_requirements: Commit to existing branch fix/complete-audit-fixes and push. PR #1 is already open.
key_patterns: Each module is a class with start()/stop() methods. Uses scapy for packet manipulation. Logging via config.log. Cross-platform support via IS_WINDOWS/IS_LINUX flags.
directory_structure: posframework/ contains all modules. Each module is a single .py file with one or more classes. config.py has shared constants/logging. __main__.py is the CLI entry point.
